title: Moonlite Fiesta credits
summary: Mills's name appears for the lyrics but Tizol wrote the music alone with Duke arranging; he doesn't remember Charlie Barnet on maracas.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Okay. And 'Moonlite Fiesta' -- that was first recorded in 1934, I believe, it says here. Right?
By dates, I can never tell you when it was.
Okay. And sometimes it is listed in discographies as Tizol and Ellington, and sometimes it is listed as Tizol, Ellington and Mills.
Well, I don't know who wrote the lyrics on that one, which I imagine, I guess, Mills getting the credit for that. That's the reason why they put Mills on there, but the music, I only did it myself.
And did Duke arrange it again? Is
that right? Oh yes. Everything I did was arranged by Duke Ellington -- most of them, anyhow.

And then there is one recording listed in the Benny Asland discography on 1937 -- June 16, 1937 -- that has Charlie Barnett listed playing maracas. Do you remember Charlie Barnett playing the maracas on one of the recordings of 'Moonlite Fiesta?'
I'm sorry, I don't remember, but if they got it down there, it must have been, you know?
And then at that time, Ellington's name wasn't on it. At that time, it's just listed as Tizol and Mills. But the other times it's been recorded, it's listed with Ellington's name, too.
